title: Industrial Truck and Tractor Operators
description: Operate industrial trucks or tractors equipped to move materials around a warehouse, storage yard, factory, construction site, or similar location.

tasks.text: Move levers or controls that operate lifting devices, such as forklifts, lift beams with swivel-hooks, hoists, or elevating platforms, to load, unload, transport, or stack material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Move controls to drive gasoline- or electric-powered trucks, cars, or tractors and transport materials between loading, processing, and storage areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Manually or mechanically load or unload materials from pallets, skids, platforms, cars, lifting devices, or other transport vehicles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lifting and loading of shipments

tasks.text: Position lifting devices under, over, or around loaded pallets, skids, or boxes and secure material or products for transport to designated areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning material handling equipment is physical

tasks.text: Inspect product load for accuracy and safely move it around the warehouse or facility to ensure timely and complete delivery.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cargo area cleanliness check is physical

dwas.name: Inspect cargo areas for cleanliness or condition.

tasks.text: Weigh materials or products and record weight or other production data on tags or labels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on weighing of materials

dwas.name: Mark materials or objects for identification.
Weigh materials to ensure compliance with specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance on vehicles or auxiliary equipment, such as cleaning, lubricating, recharging batteries, fueling, or replacing liquefied-gas tank.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Operate or tend automatic stacking, loading, packaging, or cutting machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical operation of packing/material processing machinery

dwas.name: Operate packing or other material processing equipment.

tasks.text: Turn valves and open chutes to dump, spray, or release materials from dump cars or storage bins into hoppers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment
